mechanism: frozen SO(72) byte LM + training-text 3-byte conditional cache in the native 8 MiB cycle root, mixed by validation-calibrated probability interpolation

cache.reserved_rows_purpose: online write of previously unseen 3-byte contexts

split.source: WordNet3.1 excerpt in the joint Round042 corpus

negative_findings: The flat cache ties native within a few millionths of a nat per byte.
Deleting the 80 most frequent contexts can slightly improve one seed's loss.
Generated byte samples remain largely incoherent.
The associative cache is not the learned multi-hop graph reasoner.
The cache is not end-to-end trained with the language model.
non_claims: No proven NaN-bit or physical quantum advantage.
The conventional flat cache matches the native cache numerically.
Generated text is not fluent and not open-domain.
The associative cache is not multi-hop reasoning and is not end-to-end trained.
The Alice excerpt is a single out-of-domain diagnostic, not general language evidence.
Memory deletion is not universally harmful and is not semantic truth.
No live deployment or production model.
